YQAV: Vahi guru = O Guru! You are wondrous.
Wonderful! Wonderful! O Beloved! O Guru! I am a sacrifice!
Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o.
The Wondrous, Beauteous and blest are you, O Guru-God.
O Sri Guru! You are wondrous in all four ages, meaning you are the form of Brahm. And O Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji! It is you who took birth in all four ages.
CUUX: Nain = eyes. Madhur = sweet. Bain = words. Kot sain = millions of armies, millions of beings. Sang = with (you). Sobh = look beautiful. Jisahi = to whom, (O Guru!) meaning to you, (O Guru!). Kahat = used to say. Ma Jasod = mother Jasodha. Bhat = rice. Jeeu = O beloved!
Your eyes are like lotuses; (for me it is you alone whom) mother Jasodha used to tell, 'O darling, (come,) eat yogurt and rice.'
You are lotus-eyed, with sweet speech, exalted and embellished with millions of companions. Mother Yashoda invited You as Krishna to eat the sweet rice.
You are lotus-eyed, recite sweet words and are embellished with millions of hosts. You are the one, whom the mother, Yashoda, asks to partake the curd and rice.

In the Dvapar age you became the form of Krishna, with eyes like lotuses and sweet words, and an army of millions of cowherds adorned you as your companions. And it was you to whom mother Jasodha ji used to say: O son, eat yogurt and rice.
UKZV: Dekh = seeing. At anoop = very beautiful. Maha mag bhaee = would become completely absorbed. Kinknee = waist-chain of bells. Sabad = sound. Jhanatkar = jingling. Khel pahi jeeu = when you played.
When you played, the jingling sound of your waist-bells rang out; seeing your most beautiful face, (mother Jasodha) would become absorbed in love for you.
Gazing upon Your supremely beautiful form, and hearing the musical sounds of Your silver bells tinkling, she was intoxicated with delight.
Seeing your supremely beauteous from and hearing the tinkling sound of your lion-chain, when you were at play, the mother was greatly intoxicated through love.

Your mother, seeing your beautiful form, became completely absorbed (mag) in love; or, when inside your mouth, under the pretext of the earth, you showed forms of many kinds, seeing that cosmic form your mother became deeply absorbed. And as you ran about playing, your waist-chain (kinknee) jingled. 'Jeeu' is a form of address.
UXXQ: Kal kalam = the pen of death. Hath = in (your) hand. Kahahu = say. Ees = Shiva. Thammy [sic: for 'bammy'] = Brahma. Gyan dhyan = your wisdom and meditation. Dharat heeai chahi jeeu = long to hold in their hearts.
The pen of death and the command are in (the Guru's) hand. Tell me, who can erase (the Guru's command)? Shiva and Brahma long to hold in their hearts the wisdom and meditation (given by the Guru).
Death's pen and command are in Your hands. Tell me, who can erase it? Shiva and Brahma yearn to enshrine Your spiritual wisdom in their hearts.
Death's pen and command are in your hand, and who can efface your will? Shiva and Brahma crave to enshrine your gnosis and meditation in their mind.

You are the form of death, and the pen of command is in your hand. So who can erase that command? That is, no one can erase it. And reflecting in his heart, Shiva (ees) holds meditation on that very form of yours, and Brahma holds wisdom.
UFZW: Sree nivas = the dwelling of Lakshmi. ||1||6||
O Guru! You are wondrous; you are the True Form, you are unshakable, you alone are the dwelling of Lakshmi, you alone are the Primal Being and eternal. ||1||6||
You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||1||6||
You are ever just, true, the abode of excellence and the Primeval person. My wondrous, beauteous and lustrious Guru, you are worthy of praise and reverence.

The Form that is true (sat), unaffected in all three times, and surely the giver of a dwelling to Lakshmi (sree), the Primal Being: that, Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, you alone are, imperishable in all three times, the wondrous Form (Vahiguru). ||1||6||
6VCH: Ram nam = O you whose name is Ram! O Guru, whose name is 'Ram'. Param dham = O you of the highest abode! Sudh budh = O you of pure wisdom! Nireekar = O formless one! Besumar = O infinite one! Sarbar kau = an equal, as great as you. Kahi = who is?
O True Guru! 'Ram' is your Name, and your abode is lofty. You have pure wisdom, you are formless and infinite. Who is your equal? O Guru, your mind is steady.
You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?
You are blessed with the Lord's Name, supreme mansion and clear understanding and yourself are the Formless infinite Lord. Whom should I call equal to you?

O True Guru ji! You are all-pervading (Ram) and renowned (nam), supremely radiant (param dham). You are the form of awareness, of pure form, free of form (nireekar), infinite (besumar). O Maharaj! Who can be called your equal (sarbar)?
SD4Q: Suthar = steady. Bhagat hit = for the devotee's sake. Dhario = took on. Hario = killed. Nakh bidar = tearing with the nails. Bidar = tearing.
(For me it is you alone who) took (the Narsingh) form for the sake of the devotee (Prahlad) and killed Harnakhash by tearing him with your nails.
For the sake of the pure-hearted devotee Prahlaad, You took the form of the man-lion, to tear apart and destroy Harnaakhash with your claws.
For the sake of clean-hearted saint Prahlad, you assumed the Man-lion from and destroyed and tore Harnakhsh with your nails.
To protect the pure-minded (suthar) devotee Prahlad, you took the Narsingh form (bhekh) and killed the wicked Harnakhash by tearing open his belly with your nails.
33H3: Sankh chakr gada padam = these are held to be the emblems of Vishnu. Chhadam = deception (that is, the Vaman incarnation). Ap = himself. Aparampar = infinite. Lakhai = can recognise.

O True Guru! (For me it is you alone whose) emblems are the conch, the discus, the mace and the lotus; (for me it is you alone who) made yourself into a deception (as Vaman). You are (the form of) the infinite Parbrahm; who can recognise that form of yours? O Guru.
You are the Infinite Supreme Lord God; with your symbols of power, You deceived Baliraja; who can know You?
You are the Limitless Transcendent Lord, who embellishing yourself with couch, quoit, bludgeon and lotus mark; deceived Ball, the king. Who is that who can know you (Him)?

Bearer of the conch, discus, mace and lotus, you yourself became Vaman and practised deception (chhadam); or, you have hidden that form of yours, your Parbrahm form, which is beyond (apar) all beings. Who can know (lakhai) that form of yours as 'this'? Meaning, no one can know it.
80EA: You are wondrous, you are unshakable, you alone are the dwelling of Lakshmi, you are the Primal Being, and eternal. ||2||7||
You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||2||7||
O my praiseworthy Lord, God, Master, You are ever just, true, the abode of excellence and the Primeval person.
Surely (sach), O True Form! And giver of a dwelling to Lakshmi within yourself: you are the wondrous Form in all four ages. ||2||7||
PCVC: Peet = yellow. Basan = clothes. Kund = a kind of jasmine flower, white and soft. Dasan = teeth. Pria = the beloved (Radhika). Sahit = with. Kanth = neck. Mal = garland. Sees = on the head. Mor pankh = of peacock feathers. Chahi = with delight (you wear).

O True Guru! (For me) you alone are (Krishna) of the yellow clothes, (whose) teeth are white as jasmine, (who) is with his beloved (Radhika); (who has) a garland round his neck, (who has) put on his forehead with delight a crown of peacock feathers.
As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head with the crow of peacock feathers.
You wear yellow robe, has teeth like the jasmine flower, abide with your love, has rosary upon your neck and eagerly embellish your head with the crown of the peacock feathers.

Wearer of the yellow robe, with teeth like the kund flower or a white bud, together with your beloved Radhika, a garland adorns your neck, and on your head a crown of peacock feathers is seen (chahi); or, the one whose mount (chahi) is Garud, that Vishnu, in the form of Krishna, plays such sports.

60H9: Vajeer = adviser. Dheer = steadfast. Dharam ang = the form of dharam. Uchhahi = with delight.
You are very steadfast, you need no adviser; you are the form of dharam, indescribable and unreachable; you (alone) have created this whole play with your own delight.
You have no advisors, You are so very patient; You are the Upholder of the Dharma, unseen and unfathomable. You have staged the play of the Universe with joy and delight.
You are without a minister, greatly fortitudinous, partisan of truth, Unseeable and unfathomable, by your pleasure, you have staged the world play.

Very steadfast, without any minister, the form (ang) of dharam, or the one who sets the path of dharam, indescribable and unreachable by mind and speech: you have made this play of the world with your own delight.
H88L: Teen lok = in all three worlds. Rahia samai = pervades. Sutah sidh = by your own will, naturally. Roop dhario = has appeared.
(O Guru!) Your story is beyond telling, it cannot be told; you pervade all three worlds. O king of kings! You have taken this (human) form by your own will.
No one can speak Your Unspoken Speech. You are pervading the three worlds. You assume the form of spiritual perfection, O King of kings.
O Lord, Yours ineffable discourse can be described not. You are pervading the three worlds. O King of kings, you have naturally assumed the form of the Guru.
Your indescribable story cannot be told, because you pervade the three worlds. O king of kings! You have taken this form of the True Guru of your own accord.
FFAW: O Guru! You are wondrous, the True Form, unshakable; you alone are the support of Lakshmi, the Primal Being, and eternal. ||3||8||
You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||3||8||
O my praiseworthy Lord, God, Master, You are ever just, true, abode of excellence and the primeval Person.
O Primal Form, the Perfect One! You give Lakshmi a dwelling at your feet; you are surely (sat) the True Form, and you are the wondrous Form in all four ages. ||3||8||
RD1S: The True Guru is the form of Gobind.
The True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself.
The True Guru, True Guru, True Guru is the embodiment of the Sire Lord.
O Sri Satguru! You are the form of Gobind in all three times.
41J7: Sabal malan = crusher of the mighty (that is, the proud). Kanh kuar = the young prince Kanh. Charhoo dal Ravind jeeu = the host of Ravi and Ind (the sun and the moon) rises with you (to add to your glory).

(For me) it is the True Guru himself who deceived king Bali; he breaks the pride of the proud and gives the fruit of devotion. (For me) the Guru himself is the young prince Kanh. There is no stain (in him), his drum is beating, and the host of the sun and the moon rises only to add to his glory.
Enticer of Baliraja, who smothers the mighty, and fulfills the devotees; the Prince Krishna, and Kalki; the thunder of His army and the beat of His drum echoes across the Universe.

You are the enticer of Balraja, the smotherer of the mighty, the fulfiller of the devotee, the prince Krishna and Kalki, the coming incarnation of God, the thunder of whose mounted army and the beat of drum shall be echoed all over.

Becoming Vaman you deceived king Bal; and crushing the demons, who were full of strength, giving devotees the fruits their hearts desired, becoming Krishna, you were called the son of Jasodha or Devaki. And later, becoming the stainless Nihkalank, drums will beat on the kettledrums in Sambhalpur, and the host of gods such as the sun and moon (Ravind) will ride out (charhoo) with you.
M0G2: Ravan = one who remembers. Durat davan = destroyer of sins. Sakal bhavan = everywhere. Kusal = bliss, comfort. Bhoot = beings. Devadh dev = the overlord of the gods, the god of gods. Phanind = Sheshnag, the serpent king. Sahas mukh = with thousands of hoods.

He remembers the Timeless Being, removes sins and brings comfort everywhere; he himself is in all beings, he himself is the god of gods. And (for me) he himself is even Sheshnag with a thousand mouths.
The Lord of contemplation, Destroyer of sin, who brings pleasure to the beings of all realms, He Himself is the God of gods, Divinity of the divine, the thousand-headed king cobra.

You yourself are the contemplator of the Lord, the destroyer of sin, the dispenser of bliss to all the universes, pervading all the beings, God of gods and the thousand mouthed and hooded serpent King.

O all-pervading (ravan) Form! Your Name of Ram crushes (davan) sins (durat) and brings well-being to all the worlds; and you yourself have become all beings (bhoot). O overlord of the gods (devadh dev), form of light! Sheshnag, king of the serpents, with a thousand mouths, also utters your praise.
X1WG: Hua = becoming. Karam = deeds. Jaram hua = taking birth. Kool = on the bank. Khel gind = the game of ball. Jin = who.
(For me it is the True Guru, the form of Gobind, who) took birth as the fish, the tortoise and the boar and did many deeds, who played the game of ball on the bank of the Jamuna.
He took birth in the Incarnations of the Fish, Tortoise and Wild Boar, and played His part. He played games on the banks of the Jamunaa River.
Becoming the incarnation of the Big fish, Tortoise and the Boar, you assumed their avocations. Such are You who played the game of "throw ball" at the bank of Jamuna.

Taking birth as incarnations such as the fish, the tortoise and the boar, you did wondrous deeds. And in the Krishna incarnation, on the bank (kool) of the Jamuna, you played games (gind), that is, played with a ball.
61X5: Sar = excellent. Heeai = in the heart. Dhar = keep. Man Gayand = O mind of Gayand! Gayand = the name of a Bhatt. ||4||9||
O mind of Gayand! Hold (this True Guru's) excellent Name in your heart and abandon vices; this Guru is that same Gobind. ||4||9||
Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand the True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself. ||4||9||

Says Gayand, the bard, enshrine you in your heart his sublime Name and renounce yours mind's wickedness. The True Guru, the ever True Guru, the ever and ever True Guru is the embodiment of the World-Lord.

Sri 'Goind' Bhatt ji says: O mind! Hold in your heart the Name, the essence, of such a True Guru, and abandon vices; the True Guru, the form of Gobind, is the True Form in all three times. Or, thus: O True Guru! You are the form of Gobind, unaffected in all three times; holding your Name, the essence, in my mind, I have abandoned vices. ||4||9||
NDJL: The True Guru alone is eternal.
The Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord.
The venerable Guru, the highly venerable Guru, True indeed is the most venerable Guru.
Sri Satguru ji is the True Form in all three times.
70G2: Nij = one's own (that is, one that stays with you). Nidhan = treasure. Sach jan = know for certain, understand rightly. Nis = night. Basur = day. Kalyan = comfort. Lahahi = you will obtain. Param gat = the highest spiritual state.
(O mind!) Obey the True Guru's word; this is the treasure that stays with you. Accept with certainty that this is the mantra (by which) you will have comfort day and night and gain the high state.
Respect and obey the Guru's Word; this is your own personal treasure - know this mantra as true. Night and day, you shall be saved, and blessed with the supreme status.
Know you this instruction as true, obey you the Guru's word, This alone is your personal treasure, Thiswise you shall be eternally emancipated and shall be blessed with the supreme status.

O brother! Reflect on (man) the teaching (mantr) the Guru has spoken; by this you will gain the treasure of your own true form. And by this you will gain liberation from the body (param gat), and as long as you live you will have comfort (kalyan) night and day; know this for certain (sach).
LRV6: Dhoh = cheating. Jan jan siu = with each and every person. Phandh = noose. Rat = love.
Give up lust, anger, greed, attachment and cheating everyone; remove the noose of ego (too), and give your love to the company of the holy.
Renounce sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment; give up your games of deception. Snap the noose of egotism, and let yourself be at home in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Renounce you lust, wrath, avarice and worldly love, give up deceiving one and all, snap the noose of self-conceit and be you imbued with the saints' society.
So, O brother! Give up the vices of lust, anger, greed and attachment, stop deceiving (dhoh) each and every person (jan jan), cut the noose (phandh) of ego, and love (rat) the company of the holy.
C937: Deh = body. Geh = house. Tria saneh = love of a wife. Chit bilas = the play of the mind. Seu = remember. Drirhta = firmness, faith.
This body, house, love of a wife, this (whole) world is (only) the play of the mind. Remember the lotus feet (of the True Guru); make this idea firm in (your) understanding.
Free your consciousness of attachment to your body, your home, your spouse, and the pleasures of this world. Serve forever at His Lotus Feet, and firmly implant these teachings within.
Grasp you this instruction in this world, abandon the love of your body, home, wife and mind's revelments and ever serve the lotus feet to your Guru.

The body (deh), the house (geh) and love (saneh) for a wife (tria): know this whole world to be only the play of the mind, meaning, know it to be mind alone; or, knowing this world to be the play of consciousness (chit), always serve the True Guru's lotus feet. Make such a feeling firm in your understanding.
Y93Z: O mind of Gayand! Hold (the True Guru's) excellent Name in your heart and abandon vices; the True Guru (alone) is eternal. ||5||10||
Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand. the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord. ||5||10||
Says Gayand, the bard, enshrine you in your heart the sublime Name and renounce yours mind's wickedness. The venerable Guru, the highly venerable Guru, true is the most venerable Guru.
The Bhatt named 'Gayand' says: or, O mind, (gayand) elephant! Through Sri Guru, who is the True Form in all three times, hold the excellent Name in your heart and abandon vices. ||5||10||
S8XT: Sevak kai = in (the heart-home of) the servants. Bharpoor = brimming, pervading. Jug jug = always. Vah = blessed are you. Guru = O Guru! Sadka = blessing.
O Guru! Blessed are you! You are always present in the hearts of your servants; all blessing is yours;
Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You, forever.
O my blessed Guru, it is all through yours gift, that yours attendants remain fulfilled through all the ages.
O Vahiguru! You always fulfil (bharpoor) the tasks of your servants in age after age; so they offer their heads as a sacrifice (sadka) to you.
TXQL: You are (the form of) the Formless One, (the form of) the Lord, eternal. No one can say how long you have existed.
O Formless Lord God, You are eternally intact; no one can say how You came into being.
O Formless Lord, You are eternally safe and sound. No one can say, since how long are You.
O Formless Lord! You are always secure; so no one can say since when you have existed; meaning, you are the Primal Form of all.
QD1J: Sire = created. Tai = you yourself. Aganat = (a-ganat) countless. Moh man mad ka = attachment to the mind's pride.
(O Guru!) You yourself created countless Brahmas and Vishnus, and they became attached to their own mind's pride.
You created countless Brahmas and Vishnus; their minds were intoxicated with emotional attachment.
You have created countless Brahmas and Vishnu. To them have clung the mind's worldly love and self-conceit.
You have created countless Brahmas, Vishnus and the rest, and they became attached to pride (mad) in their minds.
F3AS: Tad ka = since then, since it was created.
(O Guru, you yourself) created the 8.4 million species, and from that time on you have been giving all of them their sustenance.
You created the 8.4 million species of beings, and provide for their sustanance.
You have created eighty-four lacs of species and given to them all sustenance since that very time.
Ever since you created the 8.4 million species, you have given all of them their sustenance.
AL3Y: O Guru! Blessed are you! You are always present in the hearts of your servants; all blessing is yours. ||1||11||
Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You, forever. ||1||11||
O my blessed Guru, it is all through yours gift, that yours attendants remain fulfilled through all the ages.
O Vahiguru! You always fulfil (bharpoor) the tasks of your servants in age after age; so they offer their heads as a sacrifice (sadka) to you. ||1||11||
4RJ7: Vahu vahu = the Guru worthy of praise, the Guru full of blessing. Tamasa = the play of the world.
(This) great play (of the world) is going on, of the blessed Guru (Ramdas),
Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great is the Play of God!
Great is the play of the wondrous Lord.
This show of the world of the wondrous (vahu) Vahiguru is also most wondrous.
PY4X: (The Guru, the form of the all-pervading Lord) himself laughs, himself reflects, himself gives light to the moon and sun.
He Himself laughs, and He Himself thinks; He Himself illumines the sun and the moon.
He Himself laughs, Himself cares and Himself illumines the moon and the sun.
He himself thinks of all, and he himself laughs, meaning is pleased, and he himself by his own power makes the moon and sun shine.
TF4F: Thammhan = support, pillar. Basa = dwelling. Ghat ghat = in every heart.
(That Guru) himself is the water, himself the earth, himself the support, and he himself has made his dwelling in every body.
He Himself is the water, He Himself is the earth and its support. He Himself abides in each and every heart.
He Himself is the water, Himself the support of the earth and Himself abides in every heart.
He himself is the form of water, and he himself is the ground that holds (thammhan) it, and he himself has made his dwelling in every heart.
83VL: Nar = man. Phun = and. Sar = playing piece. Pasa = the game board.
(Guru Ramdas, the form of the all-pervading Lord) himself is the man and himself the woman; himself the piece and himself the board.
He Himself is male, and He Himself is female; He Himself is the chessman, and He Himself is the board.
He Himself is the male and Himself the female. Himself is He the chess-figure, Himself the chessboard.
He himself is man and he himself is the form of woman; he himself is the pieces (sar), the beings, and he himself is the dice of the three qualities.
QYSA: Gurmukh = O Gurmukhs! Sangat = in the congregation. Sabhai = all. ||2||12||
O Gurmukhs! All of you reflect together in the congregation: this (worldly) play of the blessed Guru (Ramdas ji) is going on. ||2||12||
As Gurmukh, join the Sangat, and consider all this: Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great is the Play of God! ||2||12||
In the society of saints, O pious person, reflect you all on this; great is the play of the wondrous Lord.
O congregation of the True Guru! Through the Guru, all of you reflect on such a Vahiguru, of whose wondrous form this wondrous world is the great show. ||2||12||
EQQE: Khel = play. Mel = gathering, the joining of the elements. Tamasa = wonder. Vahi = blessed. Guru = O Guru! Rachna = creation.
O Guru! Blessed are you; this creation is all yours (made by you); by joining (the elements) you have staged a play and a show.
You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all You, forever.
Uniting the elements together, You have created this great game and play of the word. O Wondrous Lord, all this is Your creation.
O Vahiguru! Joining the five elements, you have made this great show of the world for your own play; so this whole creation is made by you alone.
BRWV: Jal = in water. Thal = on land. Gagan = in the sky. Payal = in the underworld. Poor rahya = you pervade. Ja ke = whose.
You pervade the water, the earth, the sky and the underworld (everywhere); your words are sweeter even than amrit.
You are pervading and permeating the water, land, skies and nether regions; Your Words are sweeter than Ambrosial Nectar.
You are fullyfilling the water, dry land, the firmament and the under-world. Such are you, whose words are sweeter even than Nectar.
You yourself fill the waters, the lands, the sky and the underworld, and your words are sweeter even than amrit.
AFBM: Manahi = serve, believe in. Jachna = beg, (make) requests.
O Guru! Brahma, Rudra (Shiva) and the others serve (you); you are the death of death, (you) are (Hari), free of maya; (all people) beg (of you).
Brahmas and Shivas respect and obey You. O Death of death, Formless Lord, I beg of You.
The Brahmas and the Shivas worship The. You are the death of death. O Immaculate Lord, every one begs of You.
You, whom everyone, from Brahma ji to Shiva ji (rudr) and the others, believes in, meaning worships. O death of death, untouched by maya (niranjan)! All beings beg of you alone.

ZN5B: Gur prasad = O Guru! By your grace, by the grace of you, the Guru. Parmarath = the high state. Setee = with. Khachna = becomes joined.
O Guru! Only by your grace is the high state gained, and the mind becomes joined to the company of the true.
By Guru's Grace, the greatest thing is obtained, and the mind is involved with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
By the Guru's grace, the supreme object is attained and the mind is absorbed in the saints' society.
By the True Guru's grace, by fixing (khachat) the mind in the company of saints, you, the form of the supreme aim (paramarath), are gained.
9JXS: O Guru! Blessed are you; this creation is yours alone; by joining (the elements) you have staged this show and play. ||3||13||42||
You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all Your making. ||3||13||42||
Uniting the elements together, You have created this great game and play of the world. O God, all this is Your creation.
The show, meaning the great play of the world that you have made by bringing together opposing elements: O Supreme Lord! This creation is all yours. ||3||13||42||
JYLE: Agam = unreachable. Anant = infinite. Anad = (an-ad) whose beginning cannot be found. Ad = beginning.
The Timeless Being who is unreachable, infinite, without beginning, whose beginning no one knows,
The Lord is Inaccessible, Infinite, Eternal and Primordial; no one knows His beginning.
Unfathomable, Infinite and Eternal is the Lord, whose beginning no one knows.
Vahiguru, unreachable by mind and speech, of infinite form, without beginning, whose beginning no one knows.
G3HG: Biranch = Brahma. Nitahi = always. Bakhanai = describes.
On whom Shiva and Brahma always meditate, and whose (virtues) the Veda describes.
Shiva and Brahma meditate on Him; the Vedas describe Him again and again.
Such is the Lord, whom the Shiva and Brahma contemplate and whom the Vedas ever describe.
On whom Shiva ji, Brahma and the others meditate, and whose glory the Vedas ever tell. Shiva ji holds meditation on him, and Brahma ji, together with the Vedas, ever utters his glory.
DR2L: That Timeless Being is formless, free of enmity; no other is equal to him,
The Lord is Formless, beyond hate and vengeance; there is no one else like Him.
Formless the Uninimical is he and without Him there is not another second.
Such is the Formless One, free of enmity; there is no other like him.
CK00: Bhanjan garhan samath = able to destroy and create beings. Taran taran = a ship to carry across. Taran = ship.

9JWJ: Gur Ramdas chitah = in Guru Ramdas's heart. ||1||
That Sat Nam, the Creator-Being, dwells in Guru Ramdas ji's heart. ||1||
Sat Naam, the Great and Supreme True Name of God, the Personification of Creativity, dwells in the Consciousness of Guru Raam Daas. ||1||

At your door the flag of dharam is always flying (phaharant) to drive back the waves (tarang) of masses of sins in the world-ocean.
