The True Guru, by remembering whom a being obtains the riddhis, the eighteen siddhis and the nine treasures.
3X9Q: Balya (the poet) says: join the congregation and say to that (Guru), 'Blessed are you, blessed are you.'
So speaks BALL the poet: Blessed is Guru Raam Daas; joining the Sangat, the Congregation, call Him blessed and great.
Such is Guru Ram Dass, says, Ball, the bard. Joining the saints' society, call him you the blest, yea, the best indeed.
Sri Bal Bhatt ji says: That True Guru is Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji. O brother! Join the congregation of that True Guru and utter 'blessed, blessed'.
MQ1A: Lag = (falling at his feet). Narahu = O people! ||5||54||
The Guru Ramdas ji at whose feet the Lord is met: O people! Remember that Guru. ||5||54||
Meditate on the True Guru, O men, through Whom the Lord is obtained. ||5||54||
O men, contemplate you that True Guru, clinging to which True Guru, the Lord is obtained.
O people! Remember that True Guru, the fourth Patshah ji, by falling at whose feet the Lord is gained. ||5||54||
3Z5Q: Jin = who (Guru Ramdas ji). Pas = side, company.
(Guru Ramdas ji,) who practised the Word and attained the high state, and while serving (Guru Amardas ji) did not leave his side,
Living the Word of the Shabad, He attained the supreme status; while performing selfless service, He did not leave the side of Guru Amar Daas.
Such is the Guru, who practising the name, attained the supreme status and while performing service, abandoned not the company of Guru Amar Dass.
Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, who practised the teaching (sabad), and while serving Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji did not leave his side, that is, always stayed near him.
CPT8: Ta te = from that (Guru Ramdas ji). Gauhar = (bright as a) pearl. Gyan ujeearau = the light of wisdom. Andhyar = darkness. Ko = of.
From that (Guru) the light of wisdom, bright as a pearl, became manifest, and poverty and darkness were destroyed.
From that service, the light from the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, radiant and bright; it has destroyed pain, poverty and darkness.
From that service, the light of the jewel of gnosis became manifest by which pain, poverty and darkness were destroyed.
From serving that Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, wisdom pure as a pearl (gauhar) has become manifest, and by the light of that wisdom the darkness of pain and poverty has been destroyed.

BNY2: Jo = the people who. Tras = fear.
O poet Keerat! The people who fall at the feet of that saint (Guru Ramdas ji) have no fear of lust, anger or Yama's messengers.
So speaks Keerat the poet: those who grasp hold of the feet of the Saints, are not afraid of death, sexual desire or anger.
Says Kirat, who cling to the feet of saints by turning away from the world, they dread not lust, wrath and death.
Sri 'Keerat' the poet says: The people who turn away from the world and fall at the feet of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, the form of a saint, have no fear of lust, anger, Yama and the rest.
CE8D: Jiv = as. Ang sang Nanak gur = always with Guru Nanak. ||1||
As (Guru) Angad (Sahib ji) was always with Guru Nanak Dev ji (that is, always stayed in Guru Nanak Dev ji's presence), so Guru Ramdas (ji stayed) with Guru Amardas (ji). ||1||
Just as Guru Nanak was part and parcel, life and limb with Guru Angad, so is Guru Amar Daas one with Guru Raam Daas. ||1||
As Guru Nanak was always present with Angad, so abides Guru Amar, Dass with Guru Ram Dass.

Just as Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, joining with the heart (ang) of Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, became the Guru of the world; and as Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji came to be by joining limb to limb with Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji; in the same way Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji became the True Guru by joining limb to limb with Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji. ||1||
G2GR: Jin = who (Guru Ramdas ji). Padarath = the treasure of the Name. Nis basur = night and day. Nis = night. Basur = day.
(Guru Ramdas ji,) who by remembering the True Guru (Amardas ji) found the treasure of the Name, and who dwells at Hari's feet all the eight watches,
Whoever serves the True Guru obtains the treasure; night and day, he dwells at the Lord's Feet.
Serving the True Guru, whosoever attains the treasure of Name, night and day, he abides at the God's feet.
O Satgur Ramdas Sahib ji! By serving Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji you have attained the treasure of liberation, and day and night you dwell at the feet of that True Guru, the form of Hari.
C30T: Ta te = from that (Guru Ramdas ji). Saghan = countless. Bhai = in love. Maleeagar = sandalwood grown on the Malay mountain (Malay agr).
Countless congregations, (absorbed) in love, hold that (Guru Ramdas ji) in awe (and say): ("O Guru Ramdas ji!) You plainly have the sweet fragrance of sandalwood."
And so, the entire Sangat loves, fears and respects You. You are the sandalwood tree; Your fragrance spreads gloriously far and wide.
Therefore, the entire congregation loves and fears you. O Guru. You are the sandal tree and manifest if your fragrance.
So the whole congregation holds you in awe and loves (bhai) you, because you are like sandalwood (maleeagar). The excellent fragrance of your glory is spreading through the world.
0TWZ: The light that (appeared) to Dhru, Prahlad, Kabir and Trilochan through remembering the Name,
Dhroo, Prahlaad, Kabeer and Trilochan chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and His Illumination radiantly shines forth.
Reciting the Lord's Name, the Divine Light welled up in Dhru, Prahlad, Kabir and Trilochan.
The light of wisdom that arose in devotees such as Dhru, Prahlad, Kabir and Trilochan ji by chanting his Name.
CAEV: Jih pikhat = on seeing whom. Rahas = joy, blossoming. Man = in the mind. Sant sahar = the support of the saints. ||2||
And on seeing whom great joy arises in the mind: that support of the saints is Guru Ramdas himself. ||2||
Seeing Him, the mind is totally delighted; Guru Raam Daas is the Helper and Support of the Saints. ||2||
Seeing whom, the soul is greatly whom, the soul is greatly pleased, he, the support of the saints, is Guru Ram Dass.
On seeing whom great joy (rahas) arises in the mind, and who is the support (sahar) of the saints: that Hari is Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji. ||2||
8UVF: (Guru) Nanak (Dev ji) recognised the Name of the Pure One, and joined his attention to it in love and practised devotion.
Guru Nanak realized the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. He was lovingly attuned to loving devotional worship of the Lord.
Nanak realised the immaculate Name and lovingly fixed his attention on the Lord's devotional service.
First Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji knew the Name of the Pure One, and fixing his attention, practised loving devotion.
FD4R: Ta te = from that (Guru Nanak). Sair = ocean. Tin = he (Guru Angad Dev ji). Varkhaee [the gloss reads the line's 'rakhaee' as 'varkhaee'] = rain.
From him (came) Guru Angad Dev ji, the form of the ocean, (who) stayed always in his presence and rained down 'sabad surat' (that is, freely shared attention on the Word).
Gur Angad was with Him, life and limb, like the ocean; He showered His consciousness with the Word of the Shabad.
From him became manifest, like the ocean, Angad, who ever lived in his presence. He rained the Lord's Name on the mortal's mind.

Joining limb to limb with that Sri Gur Nanak Dev ji, Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji became a poet (sair), meaning one who sings Vahiguru's glory. He laid the foundation of awareness (surat) of Brahm (sabad), the attainment of Brahm in the form of wisdom; meaning, the Supreme Lord is attained through wisdom; or, he rained down the amrit of teaching.
NZ10: The story of Guru Amardas ji is beyond telling (Guru Amardas ji's lofty spiritual state cannot be described); I have one tongue, and nothing can be said with it.
The Unspoken Speech of Guru Amar Daas cannot be expressed with only one tongue.
Ineffable is the story of Guru Amar Dass, which cannot, at all, be told, with one tongue.
The story of Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji is indescribable; nothing of it can be told with one tongue.
TDC9: Now (from Guru Amardas ji) the greatness to carry the whole creation across has come to the Sodhi Guru Ramdas (ji). ||3||
Guru Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty has now been blessed with Glorious Greatness, to carry the whole world across. ||3||
Sodhi Guru Ram Dass has now obtained glory, in order to ferry across the whole world.
To carry the whole creation across, the greatness of Guruship of the world has now come to Sodhi Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji. ||3|| ☬ Now he prays with great humility:
B1K8: Bikh = poison. Bikhai bikh = nothing but poison. Bikhai bikh khaee = we have eaten nothing but poison.
We are full of faults, (in us) there is not a single virtue; leaving the amrit (Name), we have eaten nothing but poison.
I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.
I am brimful with sins and have not even a single virtue. Abandoning Nectar, I eat nothing but poison.
We were full of faults; there was not a single virtue in us. Leaving the amrit of the Name, we were eating the poison of sensual pleasures.
R68Q: Pai = falling. Sut = son. Dara = wife. Sau = with. Amrit = the water of the Name, which gives spiritual life.
Falling into attachment to maya and into doubts, we have strayed (from the right path of life), and we have given our love to son and wife.
I am attached to Maya, and deluded by doubt; I have fallen in love with my children and spouse.
Falling into love of riches and doubt, I am wandering about and have contracted affection with my sons and wife.
Through attachment to maya we fell into doubt and forgot our own true form, and we had given our love to false things such as son and wife.
0QEP: Tih milant = joining it. Tras = fear.
We have heard of one lofty path, that of the True Guru's congregation; by joining it we have erased the fear of Yama's messengers.
I have heard that the most exalted Path of all is the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation. Joining it, the fear of death is taken away.
I have heard that the Guru's congregation alone is the sublime path, adhering to which, the fear of death is shed.
O True Guru! When we heard of the one excellent path, your congregation, then on joining it we put an end to the fear of Yama.
699M: Now Keerat the Bhatt has one prayer: O Guru Ramdas ji! Keep me in your refuge. ||4||58||
Keerat the poet offers this one prayer: O Guru Raam Daas, save me! Take me into Your Sanctuary! ||4||58||
Kirat the minstrel, makes a supplication, O Guru Ram Dass, keep you me ever under your protection.
Sri 'Keerat' Bhatt ji says: I, your servant, have one prayer before you: O Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji! Now keep us in your refuge. ||4||58||
ZFAL: Mal = crushing. Bivas keeau = has brought under control. Gah kes = seizing by the hair. Pachharyau = has thrown to the ground.
(O Guru Ramdas ji!) You have crushed 'attachment' and brought it under control, and seized 'lust' by the hair and thrown it to the ground.
He has crushed and overpowered emotional attachment. He seized sexual desire by the hair, and threw it down.
The Guru has crushed and overpowered his worldly love and seizing lust by the hair has knocked it down.
You have especially brought under your control attachment, the wrestler (mal), and you have seized lust by the hair of its desires and thrown it down.
GK5G: Khand = cutting to pieces. Parchand = with (your) splendour. Apman siu = with contempt. Jharyau = has driven off.
(You) have cut 'anger' to pieces with (your) splendour, and driven 'greed' away with contempt.
With His Power, He cut anger into pieces, and sent greed away in disgrace.
With his power, he has cut wrath into pieces and avarice, he has disgraced and shaken off.
Anger, which is fierce (prachand), you have cut (khand) to pieces, and greed you have swept away with disdain or contempt, together with ego; meaning, you have removed all vices.
DF03: 'Birth' and 'death', with hands joined, obey whatever your command is.
Life and death, with palms pressed together, respect and obey the Hukam of His Command.
With joined hands, birth and death both obey the order, the Guru gives.
Birth and death (kal) stand before you with hands joined, and obey whatever your command is.
AYBY: Bhav sagar = the world-ocean. Suprasannai = (the Guru) who is always pleased.
You have bridged the world-ocean, and you, who are always pleased, have carried the Sikhs across (this world-ocean).
He brought the terrifying world-ocean under His Control; by His Pleasure, He carried His Sikhs across.
The world ocean, you have brought under your sway and by your supreme pleasure, you have ferried across yours disciples.
To cross the world-ocean you have built the bridge of Vahiguru's Name, and over that bridge, being pleased, you have carried the Sikhs across.
0U7K: Sir = on the head. Atapat = canopy, parasol. (Atap = sunshine; 'that which protects from the sun'.) Sachau = true, unshakable. Jog bhog sanjut = enjoying both yoga and rule. Bal = mighty.
There is a canopy over (your) head, (your) throne is eternal; you enjoy both rule and yoga, and you are mighty.
He is seated upon the Throne of Truth, with the canopy above His Head; He is embellished with the powers of Yoga and the enjoyment of pleasures.
With canopy on your head, you are seated on the True Throne and are embellished with both the spiritual and secular powers.
Over your head the canopy (atapat) of glory is swaying, and you are seated on the true throne of Guruship, endowed with the might (bal) of yoga and enjoyment.
CVV4: Salya = O poet Salya! Atal raj = of unshakable rule. Abhag dal = with an unbroken army, with an army that is never defeated. ||1||
O poet Salya! Speak the truth: "O Guru Ramdas! Your rule is unshakable and your army (of divine virtues) is imperishable." ||1||
So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign power is eternal and unbreakable; Your army is invincible. ||1||
Sall, the bard, recites the truth, O Guru Ram Dass, eternal is your rule and unconquerable your army.

Sri 'Sall' ji says: O Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji! You surely have an unshakable rule, and your army of divine virtues is free of flight (abhag); meaning, your virtues are not overpowered by faults. ||1||
AFZH: Chahu jugee = lasting through all four ages, eternal. Ape = himself.
O Guru Ramdas! You are the Guru who is steady through all four ages; (in my eyes) you yourself are the Supreme Lord.
You are the True Guru, throughout the four ages; You Yourself are the Transcendent Lord.
You are the True Guru of the four ages and you yourself are the Supreme Lord.
O True Guru ji! In all four ages you yourself are the form of the Supreme Lord.
L3F9: Dhurah dhur = from the very beginning, from the start. Sur = gods. Nar = humans. Sadhik = those who practise yoga. Sidh = yogis who have perfected the yoga practices.
Gods, humans, seekers, siddhas and Sikhs have been serving you from the very beginning.
The angelic beings, seekers, Siddhas and Sikhs have served You, since the very beginning of time.
Since the very beginning, angelic persons, strivers, adepts and disciples have been serving you.
Gods and humans, seekers and siddhas (Sikhs) have all always been serving you from the very beginning.
3AD7: (You) are from the beginning, from the beginning of the ages, and without beginning. You have established (your) power in all three worlds.
You are the Primal Lord God, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages; Your Power supports the three worlds.
O Primeval person, You are since the commencement of ages and without any beginning. Your power is giving support to the three worlds.
O beginningless One! From the beginning, from the start of the ages, you have always held power in the three worlds.
BFR2: Udharan = the one who saved. Agam nigam = the Vedas and shastras. Jara = old age. Jammihi = on Yama. Aroah = mounted.
(For me it is you who) saved the Vedas and shastras (in the form of the boar). You are mounted on old age and on Yama's messengers (that is, you have no fear of them).
You are Inaccessible; You are the Saving Grace of the Vedas. You have conquered old age and death.
The Unfathomable Lord is the Saviour of the Vedas and he has conquered old age and death.

O unreachable Form! Taking the boar incarnation and killing Sankhasur, you are the one who rescued the Vedas (nigam); and you yourself have mounted (aroh) old age (jara) and birth, meaning the six changes of the body that these stand for. The meaning is that you have overpowered them, that is, known them to be properties of the body.
EX52: Gur Amardas = Guru Amardas (ji). Thir thapiau = has made unshakable. Pargamee = one who has crossed over, liberated. Taran = ship.
Guru Amardas (ji) made (you) unshakable; you are liberated and a ship to carry others across.
Guru Amar Daas has permanently established You; You are the Emancipator, to carry all across to the other side.
Guru Amar Dass has eternally established you. You are the emancipator of mortals and a ship to ferry across.

Sri Guru Amardas ji has installed you in the steady state, and you have gone beyond the world, meaning you have reached the form of Brahm. And you are like a ship (taran) to carry people across the world-ocean.
K24V: Agh = sins. Antak = Yama. Badai na = does not count, does not care; does not fear. ||2||60||
O Guru Ramdas! The poet Salya (says): the person who has come to your refuge does not count sins or Yama's messengers. ||2||60||
So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, You are the Destroyer of sins; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||60||
Says Sall, the poet, O Guru Ram Dass, you are the destroyer of sins; therefore, I have sought Yours refuge.

You are called the ender of sins (badai na); or, you do not count sins or Yama (antak); or, you are the giver of poetic skill (kabta). Sri Sall the poet says: O Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji! I have come to your refuge. ||2||60||
1TTE: Savaiye uttered in praise of Guru Arjan Sahib ji.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fifth Mehl:
Swayas in praise of the 5th Guru.
3QSC: The Timeless Being is One and is met through the grace of the True Guru.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. But the True Guru's grace, is He attained.
4C39: I remember that imperishable and unmoving Timeless Being,
Meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord God, Eternal and Imperishable.
Meditate I on Him who is the Eternal and Imperishable Lord.
I remember that very Form, the unmoving, imperishable Being.
E7KW: By remembering whom the filth of evil understanding is removed.
Remembering Him in meditation, the filth of evil-mindedness is eradicated.
Contemplating upon whom, the filth of evil understanding is washed off.
By remembering whom the filth of false teaching in me has been destroyed.
LJ0G: Dharan = I hold. Rid = in the heart.
I enshrine the True Guru's lotus feet in my heart,
I enshrine the Lotus Feet of the True Guru within my heart.
The True Guru's lotus feet, enshrine I within my mind.
I hold your lotus feet in my heart.

XHFW: Bicharan = I reflect on. Sahaj = with ease, with love, (resting) in spiritual poise.
And with love I reflect on the virtues of Guru Arjun Dev ji.
With intuitive peace and poise, I contemplate the Glorious Virtues of Guru Arjun.
In equipoise reflect I on the virtues of Guru Arjan.
O Sri Satgur Arjan Sahib ji! I reflect on your great (gur) virtues, such as peace (sahaj).
LSU7: Gur Ramdas ghar = in the house of Guru Ramdas (ji). Keeau pragasa = appeared.
(He) was born in the house of Guru Ramdas (ji),
He was revealed in the House of Guru Raam Daas,
He made himself manifest in the house of Guru Ram Dass,
You have shone forth, meaning appeared, in the house of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji.
7RMX: All (his) wishes and hopes were fulfilled.
and all hopes and desires were fulfilled.
and all the desire and hopes were fulfilled.
The hope of all your wishes has been fulfilled.
TZWG: Janmat = from birth, from the very start. Gurmat = taking the Guru's teaching.
From birth you have recognised Brahm through the Guru's teaching (you have a deep bond with the Lord),
From birth, He realized God through the Guru's Teachings.
Through the Guru's instruction, you, O Guru, have realised the Lord since your very birth.
From your very birth, taking the Guru's teaching (mat), you have recognised Brahm.
LZL1: Jor kar = with hands joined. Kar = hands (plural).
(O Guru Arjun!) The poet Kalya, with hands joined, utters (your) praise.
With palms pressed together, KALL the poet speaks His praises.
Joining his hands Kall, the bard, recites yours sublime praise.
Sri 'Kall' ji says: With hands joined I have told your excellent glory.
9L5P: Kau = to. Jaitvar = one who conquers.
You have conquered the yoga of devotion (that is, you have attained union through devotion). Hari has made (you) a 'Janak'.
The Lord brought Him into the world, to practice the Yoga of devotional worship.
God has brought you into this world like Janak to practise the Yoga of His meditation.
You are the conqueror, meaning the holder, of the yoga of devotion. Hari has made you the form of wisdom (Janak); or, Hari (the father) has made you in his own form.
CQ5B: (You) have revealed the Guru's Word, and (you) have enshrined Hari on your tongue.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad has been revealed, and the Lord dwells on His tongue.
Through you, the Guru's word becomes manifest and the Lord abides on your tongue.
When Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji made the Word shine in your heart, then you enshrined Hari's Name on your tongue.
KFD8: Falling at the feet of Guru Nanak Dev, Guru Angad Sahib and Guru Amardas ji, (Guru Arjan Sahib ji) has attained the highest state;
Attached to Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, He attained the supreme status.
Attaching yourself to Guru Nanak, Angad and Amar Dass, You are blessed with the sublime status,

Just as Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, falling at the feet of Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, and Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, falling at the feet of Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, and Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, falling at the feet of Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, attained this highest state of Guruship:
PN6K: In the house of Guru Ramdas (ji), Guru Arjun the devotee has been born. ||1||
In the House of Guru Raam Daas, the devotee of the Lord, Guru Arjun was born. ||1||
In the house of Guru Ram Dass, Guru Arjan Dev, the saint of the Lord was born.
O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! In the same way you have descended into the house of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji as the incarnation of devotion. ||1||
5HMR: Unmaniau = is in complete bloom. Rid = in the heart.
(Guru Arjun) is greatly fortunate and in complete bloom. (He) has enshrined the Word in his heart;
By great good fortune, the mind is uplifted and exalted, and the Word of the Shabad dwells in the heart.
Very fortunate are you whose mind abides in the supreme state of bliss. The Lord's Name, you have enshrined in your mind.
Fortunate people have recognised (unmanio) you with certainty as the incarnation of devotion; or, have reflected on it; and they have enshrined your teaching (sabad) in their hearts.
WN2M: (He has) settled his jewel-like mind in contentment; the Guru (Ramdas ji) firmly implanted the Name (in him).
The jewel of the mind is contented; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within.
Your mind's jewel is contented and the Guru has implanted the Name within you.
O True Guru ji! Those in whom you have implanted the Name: their minds have become pure as jewels and have reached contentment.
FGK2: Satgur = the True Guru (Ramdas ji). Darsayau = has shown.
The True Guru (Ramdas ji) has shown (him) the unreachable, imperceptible Parbrahm.
The Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Supreme Lord God is revealed through the True Guru.
The Inaccessible and incomprehensible Transcendent Lord is beheld through you, O True Guru.
O True Guru ji! To the Sikhs who take up your teaching, you have shown the unreachable, imperceptible Parbrahm.
0XLU: Anbhau = wisdom. Thahrayau = has established. Agam = the unreachable Lord. Agochar = (a-go-char) beyond the reach of the senses. ||2||
In the house of Guru Ramdas (ji) the Timeless Being has established Guru Arjun (ji) as the form of wisdom. ||2||
In the House of Guru Raam Daas, Guru Arjun has appeared as the Embodiment of the Fearless Lord. ||2||
In the house of Guru Ram Dass, Guru Arjan Dev has been manifested as the Embodiment of the Fearless Lord.
So, O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! We have held you to be the form of Brahm (anbhau) in the house of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji. ||2||
L8FB: Janak raj = the rule of Janak (that is, the rule of wisdom). Aleena = is absorbed, prevails.
(Guru Arjan Sahib) has established the rule of wisdom; (now) the Satyug prevails.
The benign rule of Raja Janak has been established, and the Golden Age of Sat Yuga has begun.
In the Darkage, the Guru has established the benign rule of Raja Janak and the True age has dawned.
In the world you have spread the light (raj) of wisdom (Janak), and in the Kaliyug the Satyug has merged (leena) from every side (a); meaning, you have made the Satyug in the Kaliyug.
ABNC: Apateej = the mind that cannot be satisfied.
(His) mind is convinced by the Guru's Word, and this mind that could not be satisfied has been satisfied.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased; the unsatisfied mind is satisfied.
Through the Guru's word, the mind is pleased and the unsatiable soul is sated.
O True Guru ji! Those whose minds have accepted your teaching (sabad): although their minds were unconvinced, they have become convinced; the meaning is that they have placed their faith in Vahiguru.
YG7P: Saj = building. Satgur sang = in the Guru (Arjun Dev).
Guru Nanak Dev himself, having built the foundation of 'Truth', has merged into the Guru (Arjun Dev ji).
Guru Nanak laid the foundation of Truth; He is blended with the True Guru.
Laying the True Foundation, Guru Nanak is blended with the True Guru, his Lord.

Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji laid the true foundation of devotion, meaning he revealed the path to attaining Vahiguru ji, and merged himself with Sri Akal Purakh ji, the True Form (satgur), worthy of worship; in the same way Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji and Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji merged.
STJL: Aparampar = the infinite Hari. Beena = has become. ||3||
In the house of Guru Ramdas (ji), Guru Arjun Dev has become the form of the infinite One. ||3||
In the House of Guru Raam Daas, Guru Arjun has appeared as the Embodiment of the Infinite Lord. ||3||
In the house of Guru Ram Dass, Guru Arjan Dev is seen as the manifestation of the Limitless Lord.
O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! In the same way, in the house of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, you are seen (beena) as the form of Vahiguru, beyond all (aparampar). ||3||
0CJM: Goorhau = wondrous. Har rai = the Timeless Being. Samacharyio = moves about (Guru Arjun). Bimal = pure. Satgur = in the Guru (Arjun). Samanau = is absorbed.
The Timeless Being has created (this) wondrous play; (Guru Arjun) moves in contentment. Pure understanding is absorbed in the Guru (Arjun).
The Sovereign Lord King has staged this wondrous play; contentment was gathered together, and pure understanding was infused in the True Guru.
God, the King, has staged the wondrous play and has infused and amassed contentment and immaculate understanding, in the True Guru.

O Maharaj Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji, form of Hari! You have made this deep play of the world, and you have well (sam) taken up (samacharyo) contentment and, by implication, all the virtues of divine wealth, and with pure understanding you are absorbed in the True Guru.
QRHU: Ajonee = free of births. Sambhaviau = self-illumined, (svayambhu) self-manifested. Kaly kaveean = poets such as Kalya.
He is the form of Hari, free of births and self-illumined. Poets such as Kalya have uttered (his) beautiful praise.
KALL the poet utters the Praises of the Unborn, Self-existent Lord.
The poets, like Kall, recite the sublime praise of the Guru, who is the manifestation of the unborn and self-illumined Lord.

The Supreme Lord who is beyond birth has himself arisen (sambhaviau) as you. Sri Kal Bhatt ji says: Your glory has been told by the sons of poets (kaveean), or by many poets, meaning Vyas, Vashisht and others.
YAMH: Guru Nanak (Dev ji) blessed Guru Angad; Guru Angad (Dev ji) gave the treasure (of all goods) to (Guru) Amardas (ji).
Guru Nanak blessed Guru Angad, and Guru Angad blessed Guru Amar Daas with the treasure.
Guru Nanak blessed Angad and Guru Angad blest Amar Dass with the Name Treasure.

Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji blessed (varyau) Sri Guru Angad ji, or rained down teaching on him; and Sri Guru Angad ji rained down Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji; and Guru Amardas Sahib ji gave Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji the Name, the treasure of the treasures.
K1HZ: Paras = touching. Paras praman = like the philosopher's stone. ||4||
Guru Ramdas ji blessed (Guru) Arjun (Sahib ji); and touching (his feet) has become like the touch of the philosopher's stone. ||4||
Guru Raam Daas blessed Guru Arjun, who touched the Philosopher's Stone, and was certified. ||4||
Guru Ram Dass blessed Arjan Dev, who touching the Philosopher's stone, became acceptable.
O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! In the same way Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji blessed you. By touching the True Guru, the philosopher's stone, you too have become equal (praman) to that very form. ||4||
XGLW: (Guru) Arjan (Sahib) lives forever, (his) worth cannot be assessed, (he) is the form of Hari, free of births and self-illumined;
O Guru Arjun, You are Eternal, Invaluable, Unborn, Self-existent,
You, O Guru Arjan, are ever-alive, invaluable, unborn, self-existent,
Vahiguru, who is ever-living, beyond birth and self-illumined (sambhau): that priceless Form is what you have become, Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji.
XD8V: Par dukh = others' pains. Anambhau = the form of wisdom.
(Guru Arjan) removes fear, takes away others' pain, and is infinite and the form of wisdom.
the Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, Infinite and Fearless.
the destroyer of dread, the dispeller of other's pain, infinite and fearless.
Destroyer (bhanjan) of all fear, remover of others' pain, the infinite Form of experience, the (ungraspable) Supreme Lord:
FG88: Agah = beyond reach. Agah gahan = one who reaches Hari, who is beyond reach.
(Guru Arjan Sahib ji) has reached Hari, who is beyond (beings') reach; (Guru Arjan) removes doubt and wandering, is cool, and gives comforts;
You have grasped the Ungraspable, and burnt away doubt and skepticism. You bestow cooling and soothing peace.
You have seized the Unseizable Lord, has burnt off doubt and misgiving and you bless the mortals with cool comfort.
You enable him to be grasped, and you burn up, meaning remove, the confusion caused by doubt, and you are the giver of cool (seetal) peace and comfort.
MNDR: Asambhau = unborn. Udviau = has appeared. Bidhatau = the Creator, the Ordainer.
(As if) the unborn, perfect Being, the Creator, has appeared.
The Self-existent, Perfect Primal Lord God Creator has taken birth.
In your form, the self-illumined Creator and the Perfect Lord has come into being.
The perfect Being, the unborn (asambhau) Creator: you yourself have appeared (udviau) as him.
MAEB: Ad = starting from. Satgur sabad = in the True Guru's Word. Samaiau = (Guru Arjan) is absorbed.
By the blessing of Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amardas ji, (Guru Arjan Dev) is absorbed in the True Guru's Word.
First, Guru Nanak, then Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, have been absorbed into the Word of the Shabad.
Nanak, the primal Guru, Angad Dev, Amar Dass and the True Guru, have all merged in the Lord.
Starting from Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, Sri Guru Amardas ji and Sri Guru Ramdas ji have merged, through the True Guru's Word, into the form of Brahm.
YQ29: Jin = who (Guru Ramdas ji). Paras = touching (Guru Arjan). Paras = (making him) a philosopher's stone. ||5||
Blessed is Guru Ramdas ji, who, touching the Guru (Arjan ji), made him a philosopher's stone and made him like himself. ||5||
Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, who transformed Guru Arjun to Himself. ||5||
Blest, blest indeed is Ram Dass, the Great Guru, who, like the philosopher's stone, touched Arjan Dev, and make him like himself.
Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, greater (guru) than all and worthy of being called blessed with mind and speech: that philosopher's stone, touching you to himself, has united you with Brahm. ||5||
4LMZ: Jas = whose (Guru Arjan ji's). Mandar = in the (heart-)home. Siv = Hari, the form of blessing. Jugat siv rahta = stays joined to Hari.
The Guru whose glory is sung in the world, in whose heart good fortune has awoken, who stays joined to Hari,
His victory is proclaimed all over the world; His Home is blessed with good fortune; He remains united with the Lord.
He, whose victory resounds in the world, high is the fortune in his home and he remains united with his Lord.

You, whose acclaim is ringing in the world, meaning your glory is manifest, are a temple of good fortune, meaning meritorious, or the support of merits. And your mind always stays joined to Vahiguru, the form of blessing (siv).
MJZT: Medan = the earth. Medan bhar = the weight of the earth.
(Who) through great good fortune has found the perfect Guru, (whose) attention stays joined (to Hari), and who bears the weight of the earth;
By great good fortune, He has found the Perfect Guru; He remains lovingly attuned to Him, and endures the load of the earth.
Through great good fortune, I have attained to that perfect Guru, who is attuned to the Lord and who bears the load of earth.
O Sri Gur Arjan Dev ji! You have found, through great good fortune, that perfect Guru in whose Name the attention of Sheshnag, who bears the weight of the earth (medan), is fixed.
MFE3: (O Guru Arjun ji!) You remove fear and take away others' pain; the poet Kalyasahar tells your praise.
He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of the pains of others. Kall Sahaar the poet utters Your Praise, O Guru.
The Guru is the destroyer of fear and the remover of the pain of others. Kalsahar, the bard, recites your praise, O Guru.
O True Guru, destroyer of all fear and remover of others' pain! Sri 'Kalsahar' ji says: I, your servant, utter your glory.
9CYT: Kul Sodhi = in the Sodhi family. Gur Ramdas tan = the son of Guru Ramdas (ji). Dharam dhuja = bearer of the flag of dharam. ||6||
Guru Arjan Sahib, the son of Guru Ramdas ji, bearer of the flag of dharam in the Sodhi family, is a devotee of Hari. ||6||
In the Sodhi family, is born Arjun, the son of Guru Raam Daas, the holder of the banner of Dharma and the devotee of God. ||6||
In the lineage of Sodhis, Arjan the son of Guru Ram Dass, is born as the saint of God and he is the standard of piety.
O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji, son (tan) of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji in the Sodhi family! You have come as the flag of dharam and as the incarnation of Hari's devotee. ||6||
UZAN: (Guru Arjan Dev ji has) made steadfastness his dharam; (Guru Arjan) is deep in the Guru's teaching and removes others' pains,
The Support of the Dharma, immersed in the deep and profound Teachings of the Guru, the Remover of the pains of others.
He is the support of Divine faith, profound in the Guru's wisdom and the remover of the sorrow of others.
O True Guru ji! You give steadfastness to dharam, you have profound understanding, and you remove (bisaran) the pains of others.
63K2: Sar = excellent. Udar = open-hearted. Ahammev = ego.
He has the excellent Word, he is generous like Hari, and he removes ego.
The Shabad is excellent and sublime, kind and generous like the Lord, the Destroyer of egotism.
Sublime is his word, generous is he like God and is also the destroyer of ego.
Your teaching (sabad) is the essence, and like Hari you are generous (udar), the giver to all, and you remove the 'I' and 'mine' of your servants.
M3ED: Na hutai = does not run out. Gian = with wisdom. Man = in the mind.
(He) is a great giver, has the Guru's wisdom, and the eagerness in (his) mind never lessens.
The Great Giver, the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, His mind does not grow weary of its yearning for the Lord.
He is the great giver and the possessor of the True Guru's gnosis. His mind's desire to contemplate his Lord wearies not.
O True Guru ji! The eagerness (chao) in your mind to give the great gift of wisdom never tires (hutai); meaning, you always keep giving the gift of wisdom.
49YL: Na nikhutai = does not run out. Navnidh = the nine treasures.
(He) is truthful; the mantra of Hari's Name, (which is, as it were,) the nine treasures, never runs out (of his treasury).
The Embodiment of Truth, the Mantra of the Lord's Name, the nine treasures are never exhausted.
The immaculate nine treasures of the Lord's Name and Gurbani are with him and those exhaust not ever.
You speak the truth (satvant); and the Sat Nam mantra, the nine treasures, which you have, you give, and it never runs out.
HSRH: Tan = son. Sarab mai = all-pervading. Sahaj = in the state of poise.
The son of Guru Ramdas ji (Guru Arjan ji) is (the form of) the All-pervading; (he has) stretched (his) canopy in spiritual poise (that is, he enjoys the colour of poise).
O Son of Guru Raam Daas, You are contained among all; the canopy of intuitive wisdom is spread above You.
O Son of Guru Ram Dass, you are contained among all and the canopy of Divine knowledge spreads over you.
O son (tan) of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji! You are the form of all (sarab mai); over the whole world you have naturally stretched the canopy of the Supreme Lord's glory.
2KV5: Gur Arjun = O Guru Arjun Dev ji! Kalyuchrai = Kaly uchrai, Kalya says. Tai = you. Raj jog ras = the joy of rule and yoga. ||7||
The poet Kalya says, "O Guru Arjan Dev! You have understood the joy of rule and yoga" (and are enjoying it). ||7||
So speaks KALL the poet: O Guru Arjun, You know the sublime essence of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||7||
Says Kall, the bard, you, O Guru Arjan Dev, know the relish of both the secular and spiritual sovereignties.
Sri Kal ji utters: O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! You have known the taste of raj jog; meaning, you have practised yoga within rule. ||7||

0UBM: Bhai nirbhau = the Timeless Being who is free of fear. Lakh mahi = pervading hundreds of thousands of beings. Lakhayau = has shown.
(Guru Arjun Dev ji has) enjoyed that Hari whom no fear can touch, and who pervades hundreds of thousands.
In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.
Abiding in His fear, you enjoy the fearless Lord and see the Unseeable God among lacs of beings.

Becoming fearless of fear, you have enjoyed (maniau) the taste of the yoga of wisdom, and among hundreds of thousands of beings, that is, in the whole universe, you have made your servants know the one indescribable Vahiguru.
BT8T: Agochar gat = whose state is imperceptible, whose being is beyond the reach of the senses. Satgur = the Guru (Ramdas ji). Parchayau = has taught.
The Guru (Ramdas ji) has taught you of that Hari who is unreachable and profound, and whose being is beyond the reach of the senses.
Through the True Guru, You have realized the state of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord.
Through the True Guru, you have known the state of your unfathomable, incomprehensible and Profound Lord.
O True Guru ji! Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji has absorbed you in Vahiguru, who is unreachable, imperceptible and of profound state.
HWEP: Gur parchai = because of the Guru's teaching.
Because of the Guru's teaching you have been accepted (in the Lord's presence); you have practised yoga within rule.
Meeting with the Guru, You are certified and approved; You practice Yoga in the midst of wealth and power.
Meeting with your Guru, you are approved and practise detachedness even in midst of affluence,
Through the Guru's teaching (parchai) you have been accepted, and you have practised yoga within rule.
GGZN: Abhar = empty (a-bhar). Sar = (heart-)pool. Subhar = brimming full.
Blessed is Guru Arjun Dev. He has filled empty hearts to the brim (with the amrit of the Name).
Blessed, blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has filled to overflowing the pools which were empty.
Blest, blest and blest indeed is the Guru, who has completely filled the pools that were not fillable.
So, O True Guru ji! You are worthy of praise with mind, body and speech, because the heart-pools that were empty you have filled to the brim with the water of love, that is, made full.
8JP4: Gam = reach. Praman = rank, measure. Gurgam praman = the rank of the Guru's reach. Gurgam praman = because of the rank reached by the Guru, that is, because of attaining the Guru's state. Sar = in the pool.
Because of attaining the Guru's state, you have borne the unbearable state, and you are absorbed in the pool of contentment.
Reaching up to the certified Guru, You endure the unendurable; You are immersed in the pool of contentment.
Reaching up to the approved Guru, you endure the Unendurable and are merged in the sea of contentment.

By placing faith (praman) in the True Guru's reach (gam), meaning his teaching, you have borne the unbearable state; or, you have endured lust, anger and the rest, which are unbearable. In your heart-pool the whole range of virtues such as contentment is absorbed.
T19U: Sahaj = through spiritual poise. Nij jog = one's own form, true union. ||8||
The poet 'Kalya' says, 'O Guru Arjun (Dev ji)! Resting in spiritual poise, you have attained true union (with the Timeless Being).' ||8||
So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have intuitively attained the state of Yoga within Yourself. ||8||
Says Kall, O Guru Arjan, you have easily obtained union with your own Lord.
Sri 'Kal' Bhatt ji says: Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji, you have attained the yoga of wisdom (sahaj) of your own self. ||8||
VK74: Amiu = amrit, the water of the Name, which gives spiritual life. Rasna = with the tongue. Badan = from the mouth. Bar dat = the gift of a blessing. Gur soor = O hero Guru! Sabad = through the Word.
O Indescribable One! O Infinite One! O hero Guru! With your tongue you (rain) amrit, and from your mouth you give the gift of blessings; through the Word you have removed ego.
Nectar drips from Your tongue, and Your mouth gives Blessings, O Incomprehensible and Infinite Spiritual Hero. O Guru, the Word of Your Shabad eradicates egotism.
O Inapprehensible and infinite hero, the Guru, through your tongue rains Nectar, your mouth blesses gifts and your words eradicate ego.

From your mouth, with your tongue, you utter amrit (amiu) words and give blessings (bar dat). O True Guru, indescribable and infinite! By that sun (soor) of amrit teaching you have removed the darkness of ego from your servants' hearts.
2JZL: Panchahar = the destroyer of the five (organs of knowledge), (ignorance). Saharyau = held, endured.
You have destroyed ignorance, and through spiritual poise you have enshrined the still, Formless One in your heart.
You have overpowered the five enticers, and established with intuitive ease the Absolute Lord within Your own being.
You have smothered the five enticing demons and has easily established your Lord in your own home.

You have especially crushed the deer of the five sense-objects, or the lion (panchahar, panchanan) of ignorance; and naturally you have held (saharyau) the still (sunn) Supreme Self in the home of your heart.
PJPG: O Guru Arjun! Joined to Hari's Name, (you) have saved the world; (you) have enshrined the True Guru in your heart.
Attached to the Lord's Name, the world is saved; enshrine the True Guru within your heart.
Attached with the Lord's Name, the world is ferried across. That Name, the True Guru has enshrined in my mind.
O True Guru ji! The Name of Hari that you have enshrined in your heart: attaching people to that Name through teaching, you have delivered the world.
1UNZ: Kalas = a pitcher, the golden pinnacle placed on top of temples, which marks the temple. Janakah kalas = Janak's pinnacle, the pinnacle of wisdom, the pinnacle that is wisdom. Deepaiau = has made shine. ||9||
The poet Kalya says that you have made the pinnacle of wisdom shine. ||9||
So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have illliminated the highest pinnacle of wisdom. ||9||
Says Kall, the bard, O Guru Arjan Dev, you have illumined the pinnacle of the glory of yours slaves.
Sri 'Kal' ji says: O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! You have revealed (deepaiau), meaning made manifest, to your servants the Supreme Self, the form of power, meaning the crown of all. ||9||
STBX: Praman = measure, rank. Purakh praman = the form of the Timeless Being. Parthau = Arjun (of the Pandava line). Chalai nahee = does not waver, does not panic.

Guru Arjan (Dev ji) is the form of the Timeless Being; like Arjun he never panics (that is, as Arjun did not panic at the armies of enemies in the battle of Kurukshetra, so Guru Arjun Dev ji does not panic at enemies such as lust; Sanskrit: Partha, a metronymic of Arjuna).
: Guru Arjun is the certified Primal Person; like Arjuna, He never leaves the field of battle.
Guru Arjan Dev is the approved person and like Arjan, the son of Kunti, he leaves not the field.
Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji is surely (praman) the form of God (purakh); or, in fighting the chief qualities of demonic nature, he does not waver, like Arjun (parthau).
CSSD: Nam neesan = the light of the Name. Satgur sabad = by the blessing of the True Guru's Word. ||1||
The light of the Name is your lance; the Guru's Word has made you beautiful. ||1||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is His spear and insignia. He is embellished with the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||
His spear and standard are the Name and he is embellished with the True Guru's word.
O True Guru! You visibly (neesan) hold the lance of the Name, and you are adorned with the Word of the True Gurus. ||1||
ACW5: Sair = ocean. Set = bridge. Bohitha = ship.
The world is an ocean; the Name of the Timeless Being is the bridge and the ship.
The Lord's Name is the Boat, the Bridge to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
God's Name is the bridge and boat to cross the dreadful water of the world ocean.
To cross this ocean (sair) of the world, filled with the water of fear, you have Hari's Name alone, like a bright (set) ship (bohitha).
WQ1U: Tua = your. San = with. Het = love. Udharyau = has saved (from the world-ocean). ||2||
You love the Guru; joined to the Name (of the Timeless Being), you have saved the world (from the world-ocean). ||2||
You are in love with the True Guru; attached to the Naam, You have saved the world. ||2||
You have love with the True Guru. Attaching to the Name, you have saved the world, O Guru.
O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! You have love (het) for the True Guru, and so, attaching it to the Name, you have delivered the world. ||2||
BH6Z: You have obtained the Name, which carries the world across, through the Guru's being pleased.
The Naam is the Saving Grace of the world; by the Pleasure of the True Guru, it is obtained.
Through the True Guru's pleasure, I am blessed with the Name, the emancipator of the world.
O True Guru ji! Through your being pleased (tuthai), we have obtained the Name that delivers the world.
UZL5: Avar sar = with anyone else. Barantar = at the door. Pooree parhee = affairs have been accomplished. ||3||12||
Now we have no need of anyone else. At (Guru Arjan Dev ji's) door all our affairs have been accomplished. ||3||12||
Now, I am not concerned with anything else; at Your Door, I am fulfilled. ||3||12||
Now I have no concern with any other. Repairing to your door, O Guru, I am fulfilled.

So now our task of liberation has been accomplished, and no other task remains; meaning, all our wishes have been fulfilled. By coming to your door (barantar) our affair has been completed; meaning, by coming to your court we have been fulfilled. ||3||12||
CU5P: Hari, the form of light, had himself called Guru Nanak.
The Embodiment of Light, the Lord Himself is called Guru Nanak.
God, the Embodiment of Light, has caused Himself to be called Guru Nanak.
Hari, the form of light, himself took the name Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji.
E8LK: From him (Guru Nanak Dev ji) (Guru Angad appeared); (Guru Nanak Dev ji's) light merged with (Guru Angad ji's) light.
From Him, came Guru Angad; His essence was absorbed into the essence.
From him Angad Dev became the Guru, whom he, forthwith, united with the Primal Lord.
From him Sri Angad Sahib ji became the Guru, whom Guru Nanak ji at once (tat) united with the Essence (tat).
QLMY: (Guru) Angad (Dev ji) in his grace established Amardas ji as Guru;
Guru Angad showed His Mercy, and established Amar Daas as the True Guru.
Showering his benediction, Angad Dev established Amar Dass as the True Guru.
Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, in his grace, installed Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji on the throne of Guruship.
JQ0C: (Guru) Amardas (ji) gave his own canopy to Guru Ramdas (ji).
Guru Amar Daas blessed Guru Raam Daas with the umbrella of immortality.
Amar Dass blessed Guru Ram Dass with the ambrosial umbrella.
Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji gave Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji the immortal (amrat) canopy, together with Guruship.
W30N: Amrit bayan = the words (of Guru Arjun ji) that give spiritual life.
Mathura says that 'having had the vision of Guru Ramdas (ji), (Guru Arjun Dev ji's) words have become life-giving.
So speaks Mat'huraa: gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of Guru Raam Daas, His speech became as sweet as nectar.
Says Mathura, seeing the vision of Guru Ram Dass, Nectar-sweet became the speech of Arjan Dev.
Sri 'Mathra' Bhatt ji says: Having touched the vision of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, his words are like amrit.
ZEZX: Panch = fifth. Praman purakh = the form of the Timeless Being. Pikhahu = see. Nayan = with the eyes. Kah = says. ||1||
See with your eyes Guru Arjun Dev ji, the fifth form, the form of the Timeless Being. ||1||
With your eyes, see the certified Primal Person, Guru Arjun, the Fifth Manifestation of the Guru. ||1||
With yours eyes, see you the embodiment of the approved person, Arjan Dev, the filth Guru.
Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji has become the true Being (praman purakh), the fifth incarnation. O people! See his form with your eyes. ||1||
WVLR: (Guru Arjun Dev ji has) held truth and contentment in his heart, and enshrined within him that Hari whose form is true and whose Name is eternal.
He is the Embodiment of Truth; He has enshrined the True Name, Sat Naam, Truth and contentment within His heart.
The True Name of God, the Embodiment of truth, righteousness and contentment, Guru Arjan has enshrined within his mind.
Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji has held in his heart meditation on the True Form, the Sat Nam, and virtues such as truth and contentment.
BXKM: Ad purakh = the Timeless Being. Mastak = on the forehead. Dhur = from the beginning, from the start. Achhar = destiny, writ.
Plainly, the Timeless Being wrote the writ on your forehead from the very beginning.
From the very beginning, the Primal Being has written this destiny upon His forehead.
Since the very beginning, the Primal Lord had manifestly written on his forehead this destiny.
Vahiguru ji, the Primal Being, has plainly written on his forehead from the very beginning (dhur) the letters, meaning the writ, of Guruship.
FBQK: Bhua mandal = on the earth. Chhayau = has spread.
(In you) the light (of Hari) is plainly shining, (your) radiance has spread over the earth.
His Divine Light shines forth, dazzling and radiant; His Glorious Grandeur pervades the realms of the world.
His Divine Light is manifestly glittering and his grandeur is pervading the world realm.
That Maharaj whose light is plainly shining, and whose radiance has spread over the sphere of the earth.
FEM9: Paras = the Guru worthy of being touched. Gur = from the Guru, through the Guru. Kahayau = was called.
Touching the philosopher's stone (Guru), the (Guru) worthy of being touched, (you) were called Guru, from the Guru.
Meeting the Guru, touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was acclaimed as Guru.
Meeting with, being in communion with, and joining with Guru, the philosopher's stone, he was acclaimed as the Guru.

Just as Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, by touching Sri Guru Nanak Dev, the form of the philosopher's stone, became a True Guru like the philosopher's stone, and the same applies to all the True Gurus: in the same way, by touching Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, the philosopher's stone, Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji came to be called the True Guru.
F2LQ: Bhan = say. Moorat = in the form. Thir chit lai = joining the mind well.
Mathura says: join your mind well to (Guru Arjun Dev ji's) form and stay facing him.
So speaks Mat'huraa: I constantly focus my consciousness on Him; as sunmukh, I look to Him.
Says Mathura, I ever fix my attention on his being and remain obedient to him,
Sri Mathra Bhatt ji says: This is my feeling: fix your mind on this fifth form and always stay facing him.
2NJC: Kalijug = in the Kaliyug. Sagal srist = O whole creation! (that is, O people of the world)! Bitarahu = cross over. ||2||
Guru Arjun is the ship in the Kaliyug. O people of the world! Fall at his feet and cross safely over (the world-ocean). ||2||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, Guru Arjun is the Boat; attached to him, the entire universe is safely carried across. ||2||
In the Dark age, Guru Arjan is the ship and the entire world attached to it is safely ferried across.
In the Kaliyug, Sri Guru Arjan Dev ji is like a ship to carry beings across the world-ocean. ||2||
S413: Jan = O people! Tih jachahu = beg of him. Jagatr par = in the whole world. Janeeat = is manifest. Basur = day. Rayan = night. Bas = dwelling. Hit = love. Siu = with.
O people! Beg at the door of that Guru, who is manifest in the whole world, and whose love and dwelling are with the Name day and night,
I beg from that humble being who is known all over the world, who lives in, and loves the Name, night and day.
I crave from that person alone who is renowned the world over and who, by day and night, loves and lives by Name.
Whose dwelling is known to be beyond the world, and whose love day and night is with Hari's Name: O brother! Whatever you wish, beg (jachahu) of that Sri Guru Arjan Dev ji; or, I beg of him.
W82P: Sang [sic: the line reads 'rang'] = in love. Te = from. Pai = but. Dham = house.
Who is completely detached, steeped in Hari's love, beyond desire; yet he is seen living as a householder.
He is supremely unattached, and imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; he is free of desire, but he lives as a family man.
He is supremely detached, imbued with the supreme Lord's love, without desire however, apparently is a family man.

Supremely detached (ateet) from the world, he is dyed in the colour of the Supreme Lord and is outside, that is, free of, desire. And yet (pai) he is seen engaged with the household; meaning, while doing all worldly business he stays untouched by all.
KPAS: Apar parampar purakh = the infinite Hari. Ras = taste, love. Aurai kam siu = with any other work.
(Guru Arjun, whose) love is fixed on the infinite Hari, and who has no need of any other work but Hari,
He is dedicated to the Love of the Infinite, Limitless Primal Lord God; he has no concerns for any other pleasure, except for the Lord God.
He is dedicated to the love of the Infinite and limitless Lord and without his Master, he has no concern with any other relish.
Whose love is well (par) fixed on the perfect Being, who is beyond (apar) other beings, and who has no love (ras) for any work but the Lord.
M25K: Ram pai siu mil rahio = is joined to Hari's feet. ||3||
That Guru Arjun himself is Mathura's all-pervading Lord; for the sake of devotion he is joined to Hari's feet. ||3||
Guru Arjun is the All-pervading Lord God of Mat'huraa. Devoted to His Worship, he remains attached to the Lord's Feet. ||3||
Guru Arjan Dev, the Lord of Mathura, the bard, is the All-pervading God. For the sake of His meditation, he remains dedicated to the Lord's feet.

The Bhatt 'Mathra' says: The Lord (prabh) of me, the servant, is Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji, who, gaining love (het pai) in devotion to Ram, who is the form of all (mai), remains one with that all-pervading Form. ||3||

CGW3: Srabai = all. Jog = the practice of yoga. Karee = did.
All the gods and silent sages did not find (Guru Arjun's) end. Indra and Shiva practised yoga,
All the gods, silent sages, Indra, Shiva and Yogis have not found the Lord's limits
All the gods, sages, Indra and great Shiva, who practised Yoga, have found not the Lord's limit and not even Brahma,

Vahiguru, whose end even all the gods cannot find. The great sage, the Indra among silent sages, and the great yogi Shiva ji, the doer of yoga (jog karee), who has practised the way of yoga, they too do not find his end.
EZ9F: Phun = and. Biranch = Brahma. Na chhadyau = did not leave.
And Brahma grew weary reflecting on the Vedas; he did not leave the chanting of Hari for even a moment.
not even Brahma who contemplates the Vedas. I shall not give up meditating on the Lord, even for an instant.
who continues reflecting upon the Vedas; so, I leave not the Lord's meditation even for an instant.
To attain whom Brahma keeps reflecting on the Vedas, and who has not left the chanting of Hari for even a moment.
RUNE: The Lord of the servant Mathura (Guru Arjun) is merciful to the meek; he has made the congregation and the creation rapturous.
The God of Mat'huraa is Merciful to the meek; He blesses and uplifts the Sangats throughout the Universe.
The Lord of the slave Mathura, is merciful to the meek and He blesses the societies of saints throughout the whole world.
Sri Mathra ji says: The Lord of me, the humble servant, is merciful; that Hari, in the form of Sri Guru Ramdas, has fulfilled (nihal) his congregation in the creation.
9NT0: Ramdas guroo = Guru Ramdas. Gur jot = the Guru's light. ||4||
To carry the world across, Guru Ramdas ji placed the Guru's light in Guru Arjun. ||4||
Guru Raam Daas, to save the world, enshrined the Guru's Light into Guru Arjun. ||4||
To emancipate the world, Guru Ram Dass enshrined the Guru's Light into Guru Arjan.
That Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, to carry the beings of the world across, then placed the light of Guruship in Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji. ||4||
UL6B: Aur na = no other. Jag maha tam mai = in the great darkness of the world. Tam = darkness. Mai = mahi, in. Ujagar = great, renowned. An = bringing.
In this pitch darkness of the world there is no other (protector but Guru Arjun); (Hari) brought him and made him a renowned incarnation.
In the great darkness of this world, the Lord revealed Himself, incarnated as Guru Arjun.
In this world, there is no other saint. Arjan, the Lord has make manifest, as His own incarnate.
When there remained no other great soul in this world to protect dharam, then the Supreme Lord himself made manifest his renowned (ujagar) incarnation, Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji.
AXZ3: O Mathura! Those who have drunk the amrit of the Name (from him), millions of their pains have gone away.
Millions of pains are taken away, from those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, says Mat'huraa.
Of those, millions of sorrows are dispelled, who through him in-drink the Name-Nectar, says Mathura.
Sri Mathra ji says: Those who have drunk the amrit Name through that True Guru: the pains of their millions upon millions of births have gone away.
BWWW: Padhat = path. Te = from. Mat = lest. Chookahi = you stray. Bhed = difference, distance. Beeau = second.
O my mind! Do not stray from this path; do not think there is any distance, that Guru Arjun is a second (separate from Hari).
O mortal being, do not leave this path; do not think that there is any difference between God and Guru.
O man, you miss not this path of the Guru and you destroy the very idea of distinction between the Guru and God and deem not the Guru as another.
So, O my mind! Do not forget this way of the Guru. Cut away (bibhed) the idea of difference between the True Guru and Hari; do not know the True Guru ji as any other (beeau) than the Creator.
KC5T: Hari, the perfect Brahm, has plainly made his dwelling in Guru Arjun's heart. ||5||
The Perfect Lord God has manifested Himself; He dwells in the heart of Guru Arjun. ||5||
God, the Omnipresent Lord, has manifestly taken His abode in the mind of Guru Arjan.
In the heart of Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji, Hari, the perfect Brahm, has himself plainly made his dwelling. ||5||
8JNF: Jab lau = as long as. Lilar bhag = the destiny of the forehead. Udai = awoke. Bahu dhayau = running a great deal.
As long as the destiny on (our) foreheads had not awoken, we wandered and ran about a great deal,
As long as the destiny written upon my forehead was not activated, I wandered around lost, running in all directions.
So long as destiny on my forehead appeared not, till then I wandered and ran about in various directions.
As long as the destiny on our foreheads had not risen, we kept running about a great deal, wandering in many places.
S5B7: Ghor = fearsome. Boodat the = were drowning. Pachhutayau = regret. Re = O brother!
We were drowning in the fearsome ocean of the Kaliyug; O brother! Our regret never went away.
I was drowning in the horrible world-ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and my remorse would never have ended.
I was drowning in the terrible ocean of this Darkage and my sorrowing would have ended not ever.
O brother! In this Kaliyug we were drowning in the fearsome (ghor) world-ocean; had the Guru ji not met us, our remorse would never have ended.
7619: Tat bichar = the true reflection. Yahai = is this.
But, O Mathura! Now the true reflection is this: to carry the world across, (Hari has) made (Guru Arjun his) incarnation,
O Mat'huraa, consider this essential truth: to save the world, the Lord incarnated Himself.
O Mathura, think you as the quintessence, that to emancipate the World, Lord has incarnated Himself.
Sri 'Mathura' ji says: The essence (tat) of all reflection, the right reflection, is this: the Formless One himself has made the incarnation of the True Guru to carry beings (jag) across.
ZQ32: Those who have meditated on Guru Arjun Dev (ji) do not come again into the womb, births and pains. ||6||
Whoever meditates on Guru Arjun Dayv, shall not have to pass through the painful womb of reincarnation ever again. ||6||
Whosoever meditates on Guru Arjan Dev, he passes not again through the pain of births and womb.
The person who has meditated on Sri Guru Arjan (Dev) Guru does not come again into the pain of the womb of births; meaning, they become free of birth and death. ||6||
ZCYX: To carry beings across the ocean of the Kaliyug, Guru Arjun Dev ji has appeared as the form of Hari's Name,
In the ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name has been revealed in the Form of Guru Arjun, to save the world.
In the ocean of the Ironage, the Lord's Name has become manifest in the embodiment of the Guru, to ferry across the world.
In this Kaliyug Sri Guru Arjan Dev has appeared as the form of Hari, who, giving beings the teaching of the Name, delivers them from the world-ocean.
1TYJ: In his heart dwells the Saint (the Lord, the source of peace); he removes pains and poverty.
Pain and poverty are taken away from that person, within whose heart the Saint abides.
He, within whose mind the Saint abides, his pain and poverty are wiped off,
In whatever person's heart he dwells, he removes their pain and poverty.
8V96: Bhekh = form. Nirmal = pure. Apar = of the infinite Lord.
There is no other but that (Guru Arjun); he is the pure form of the infinite Hari.
He is the Pure, Immaculate Form of the Infinite Lord; except for Him, there is no other at all.
The Guru is the Immaculate form of the Infinite Lord. Without him there is not any other.
Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji is the form (bhekh) of that Formless One, infinite and pure of form; apart from him there is no other human form like it.
H23X: The (person) who has recognised Hari with mind and words has become just like Hari.
Whoever knows Him in thought, word and deed, becomes just like Him.
Whosoever through the thought and word knows the Guru, he becomes like him.
Whoever has known Vahiguru with mind, word and deed has become like him.
VLB0: Dharan = earth. Gagan = sky. Mahi = in. Bhar = pervading.
(Guru Arjun himself), as the form of light, pervades the earth, the sky and the nine regions.
He is totally pervading the earth, the sky and the nine regions of the planet. He is the Embodiment of the Light of God.
He is fully contained in the earth, the sky and the nine regions as the embodiment of the Lord's Light.
He who, as the form of light, pervades the earth, the sky and all the nine regions.
AGPB: O Mathura! Say: Guru Arjun is plainly the Timeless Being. There is no difference. ||7||19||
So speaks Mat'huraa: there is no difference between God and Guru; Guru Arjun is the Personification of the Lord Himself. ||7||19||
Says Mathura, there is no distinction between the Guru and God. Guru Arjan is manifestly the Lord himself.
Sri Mathra Bhatt ji says: There is no difference between that Creator and the True Guru; so Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji is plainly the form of Hari. ||7||19||
BDGE: Ajai = unconquerable, divine. Gang jal = the water of the Ganga. Atal = eternal. Navai = bathes.
(In Guru Arjun Dev ji's court) never-ending Ganga water (of the Name is flowing, in which) the whole congregation bathes.
The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. The Sikhs of the Sangat all bathe in it.
Unconquerable and unfailing is water of the Guru's Ganges. His disciples and congregation all bathe therein.
O Guru, form of the Supreme Lord! The Ganga water of your glory, which cannot be conquered (ajai) by anyone, is unshakable in your court, and in it all the people of your Sikh congregation bathe.
S22L: Bachahi = are read. Mukh = with the mouth. Gavai = sings. Puran = the eighteen religious books written by the sage Vyas.

(In his presence) the Puranas (the religious books written by the great sage Vyas) are always read, and Brahma (too, in his presence) sings the Vedas with his mouth (that is, even great gods and learned sages such as Vyas and Brahma think themselves fortunate to wait at Guru Arjan's door. For me the Guru's bani alone is the Puranas and the Vedas).
It appears as if the holy texts like the Puraanaas are being recited there and Brahma himself sings the Vedas.
The Puranas ever dwell upon the Guru and Brahma too with his mouth sings his praise through his Vedas.
Every day the Puranas are read before you, and Brahma ji sings your glory with his mouth through the Vedas.
3XJN: A divine chaur sways over (his) head; he has (always) uttered with his mouth the Name that gives spiritual life.
The invincible chauri, the fly-brush, waves over His head; with His mouth, He drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
Over his head waves invincible fly brush and with his mouth he quaffs the Name-Nectar.
The unconquerable chaur of Vahiguru's glory is swaying over your head, and you have taken the amrit of the Name through your mouth, meaning you have chanted it.
T9JZ: Guru Arjun sir = on Guru Arjun's head. Parmesar = the Supreme Lord.
The Supreme Lord himself has bestowed this canopy over Guru Arjun Dev ji's head.
The Transcendent Lord Himself has placed the royal canopy over the head of Guru Arjun.
The Transcendent Lord Himself has placed the royal canopy over the head of Guru Arjan Dev.
O Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji! You are the incarnation of the Supreme Lord; Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji has given you this canopy of Guruship over your head.
FMP0: Mil = meeting. Har pah = beside Hari.
Meeting Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amardas ji, Guru Ramdas ji has merged into Hari.
Guru Nanak, Guru Angad, Guru Amar Daas and Guru Raam Daas met together before the Lord.
Nanak, Dev, Angad Dev, Guru Amar Dass and Guru Ram Dass repaired to the Lord and got blended with Him.

Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, joining with Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, and Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, joining with Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, and Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, joining with Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, have attained Hari's form, free of all limiting attributes.
Y1LS: Harbans = O poet Harbans! Jagat = in the world. Sancharyau = has spread. Mil gur = meeting the Guru. Muyau = has died. ||1||
O Harbans! The True Guru's glory is spreading through the world. Who says that Guru Ramdas ji has died? ||1||
So speaks HARBANS: Their Praises echo and resound all over the world; who can possibly say that the Great Gurus are dead? ||1||
Says Harbans, the bard, their praise has permeated the whole world. Who says, that the Venerable Gurus are dead?

Sri 'Harbans' ji says: Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, whose glory is spreading (sancharyau) through the whole world: so who is the person who would say that the Guru ji has died? The meaning is that the True Guru ji is forever free of birth and death. ||1||
N43J: Dev puree = the land of Hari, Sach Khand. Bhayau = was pleasing.
(Guru Ram Das) has gone to Sach Khand; this was the will that pleased Hari.
When it was the Will of the Transcendent Lord Himself, Guru Raam Daas went to the City of God.
When the Transcendent Lord, Himself, so willed, Ram Dass, the Guru, went into the Lord's abode.
When leaving the body pleased the mind of the True Guru, himself the form of the Supreme Lord, then Satguru Ramdas Sahib ji entered the radiant (dev) city of Vaikunth.
ERNS: Har = Hari. Singhasan = throne. Tah = there.
Hari gave (him) a throne and seated Sri Guru (Ramdas ji) on it.
The Lord offered Him His Royal Throne, and seated the Guru upon it.
God gave him his Royal Throne and seated the Sire Guru on the throne.
Hari gave his own throne to the True Guru, his own form, and seated him on it right beside himself.
9E67: Rahas = joy, celebration. Surdev = the gods. Tohi jas = your glory.
The gods have celebrated, and are singing your glory and acclaim.
The angels and gods were delighted; they proclaimed and celebrated Your victory, O Guru.
The angels and gods were pleased and they proclaimed your victory and praise, O Guru.

At that time Vishnu ji, god of the gods, showed great joy (rahas), just as the great Vishnu ji had shown joy on seeing Krishna ji. And Vishnu ji said: Ramdas Sahib ji, everyone utters (jampahi) your glory with cries of victory.
6KLH: Asur = demons. Te = all of them.
Those (demons) have all fled (from there); (their own) sins tremble within them.
The demons ran away; their sins made them shake and tremble inside.
The demons, they fled away for, their sins trembled within them.
For those who thus utter your glory, the demons of lust, anger and the rest, and the other sins that were in their inner selves, have all trembled and fled.
BKS1: Tin narahu ke = of those people.
The sins of those people who have met Guru Ramdas have been cut away.
Those people who found Guru Raam Daas were rid of their sins.
The persons, who attained to Guru Ram Dass, were rid of their sins.
O Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji! Those who have attained your form, or meditation on your lotus feet: you have cut away all the sins of those people.
DQ07: Guru Ramdas has given the canopy and throne of the earth to Guru Arjun Sahib ji and come. ||2||21||9||11||10||10||22||60||143||
He gave the Royal Canopy and Throne to Guru Arjun, and came home. ||2||21||9||11||10||10||22||60||143||
The Guru came after giving the canopy and the throne of the earth to Guru Arjan Dev.

Then the gods, from Vishnu onward, say: Having given Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji the canopy and throne of Guruship on the earth, you yourself have come to your own abode of Vaikunth. ||2||21||9||11||10||10||22||60||143||
